subject: english
prompt: A text says, “The museum opened in 1998. In my view, its new building is beautiful.” Which statement is correct?

options.text: The first is a fact and the second is an opinion.
The first is an opinion and the second is a fact.

answer.explanation: An opening year can be verified; “beautiful” is a personal evaluation introduced by “In my view.”。正確答案為選項 C：「The first is a fact and the second is an opinion.」。最後把這個選項放回題幹，確認它同時符合題目條件與本單元判準。

solutionSteps: 讀題定位：先找出本題要判斷的核心條件與限制；題幹是「A text says, “The museum opened in 1998. In my view, its new building is beautiful.” Which statement is correct?」。

建立本題判準：先記下題幹「A text says, “The museum opened in 1998. In my view, its new building is beautiful.” Which statement is corre…」的要求，再用答案解析指出的核心理由「An opening year can be verified; “beautiful” is a personal evaluation introduced by “In my view.”」作為逐項比對標準。
核對正確選項 C：The first is a fact and the second is an opinion.。依題目解析，An opening year can be verified; “beautiful” is a personal evaluation introduced by “In my view.”
